content: Mehn Israel ko Kalowehdi mehn Kenan kan
Ni ahnsou me nanmwarkien Arad, mehn Kenan men me kin ketiket palieir en sahpwo, karongehda me mehn Israel ko kohkohdo nanial en Adarim, e ahpw mahweniong irail oh salihedi ekei irail.
Mehn Israel ko eri kahula oh inoukihong KAUN-O, patohwan, “Ma komwi pahn ketikihong aramas pwukat pahn at manaman, se pahn patohwan kasarawiong komwi douluhl
ar kahnimw kan.”
KAUN-O eri ketin karonge mehn Israel ko oh e ahpw ketikihong mehn Kenan ko pahn ar manaman. Mehn Israel ko eri kamwomwirailla douluhl iangahki ar kahnimw kan; ihme re kahdanekihla wasao Orma.
Sineik Prons men
Mehn Israel ko eri mweselsang nin Nahna Or kolahng ni Sehden Akapa, pidipidahki likin wehin Edom. Ahpw aramas ako sohla kak kanengamahiong apwal en seiloako;

re ahpw tapihada lipanedihada Koht oh Moses, ketihtihki, “Dahme komw waikinkitodohsang Isip? Pwe se en kodohng mehla nan sapwtehnet, wasa me sohte kisin tungoal, oh sohte pihl? Se solahr kak tungoale kisin tungoal sakanakan wet!”
KAUN-O eri ketin kadarala sineik pwoisin kei rehn aramas ako me keirailpene oh kemehla mehn Israel tohto.

Aramas ako eri kohla rehn Moses oh ndaiong, “Se dipadahr ong KAUN-O oh pil ong komwi ni at lipanedih kumwa. Eri, komw kasakaskin kiht rehn KAUN-O pwe en ketikihsang sineik pwukat.” Moses eri kapakapki aramas ako.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses en wiahkihda mete emen sineik oh langahda ni apwoat tuhkehn, pwe mehmen me sineik kan pahn ngalispene ahpw kilengdahng, e pahn mourla.
Moses eri wiahda sineik men sang prons oh langahda ni tuhke pwoat. Pwe mehmen me sineik kan pahn ngalispene en kak kilengdahng oh e ahpw pahn mwahula.
Sang Nahna Or Kolahng Wahun mehn Mohap kan
Mehn Israel ko ahpw mwekidla oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko Apod.
Mwurin ar mweselsang wasao re kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan mohn imwen Aparim nan sapwtehn ni palimesehn sapwen mehn Mohap kan.
Mwuhr re ahpw kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Wahun Sered.
Sang wasao re pil mwekidla oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan ni paliepeng en Pillap Arnon, nan sapwtehn me kohla lel sapwen mehn Amor kan. (Arnon iei irepen sapwen mehn Mohap oh sapwen mehn Amor.)
Ih kahrepen Pwuken Mahwen kan en KAUN-O koasoia “...kisin kahnimw en Wahep nan Supa, oh wahu kan; Pillap Arnon,
oh wasa ukedi en wahu kan me kolahng kahnimw Ar oh lellahng irepen Mohap.”
Sang wasao re ahpw kohla wasa kis me adaneki Pwarer Kan, wasa me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses, “Kapokonepene aramas akan pwe I pahn kihong irail pihl.”
Ni ahnsowo mehn Israel ko ahpw koulki koul pwoatet:

content.text: Pwarer kan, kakusada amwail pihl;
se ahpw pahn pereperen kasamwohki at koul—
pwarero me soupeidi kan weirada
oh kaunen aramas akan weirkihda
reireiso pwoat
oh arail sokon kan.”

content: Re mwekid sang nan sapwtehn kolahng Madana,
oh sang mwo re kohla Nahaliel, oh sang Nahaliel kolahng Pamod,
oh sang Pamod kolahng wahun sapwen mehn Mohap kan, pahn kumwen Nahna Piska, sallahng sapwtehno.
Lohdien Nanmwarki Sihon oh Nanmwarki Ok
Mehn Israel ko eri kadaralahng Sihon, nanmwarkien mehn Amor, meninkeder kei me ketihtihkihong,

“Komw kupwurkalahngan mweidohng kiht se en patohwan kotehla sapwellimomwi wehi. Kiht oh nait kou kan sohte pahn patohsang nan ahl, se sohte pahn keid nansapw de nan mwetin wain kan. Se sohte pahn nimasang pilen sapwellimomwi pwarer kan. Se pahn keid nan allap, se lao daulih sapwellimomwi wehi.”
Ahpw Sihon sohte kupwurki mehn Israel ko en kotehla sapwellime wehi. Iei me e kapokonepene sapwellime karis oh ketla Sahas nan sapwtehn oh mahweniong mehn Israel ko.

Ahpw mehn Israel ko kemehla kiden imwintihti nan mahwen oh kalowehdi sapwen mehn Amor ko sang Pillap Arnon ni paliepeng en Sappok lel ni irepen mehn Ammon kan, pwe mehn Ammon kan kin sinsile mwahu sapwarailo.
Mehn Israel ko eri kalowehdi kahnimw koaros en mehn Amor iangahki Espon oh kahnimw koaros me mi limwah, re ahpw kousoanla wasa ko.
Espon iei poahsoan kaunen sapwellimen Sihon kahnimw, nanmwarkien mehn Amor kan, me mahweniong mahs nanmwarkien Mohap oh kalowehdi sahpwo pwon lellahng Pillap Arnon.
Ih kahrepen koul pwoatet me ketihtihki,

content.text: “Kumwail kohdo nan Espon, sapwellimen Nanmwarki Sihon kahnimw!
Se men kilang eh pahn kokouda oh onohnda sapahl.
Ahnsou ehu sang wasaht nan kahnimw Espon
sapwellimen Sihon karis mwekidsang ie rasehng mpwul en kisiniei;
e kamwomwala kahnimw Ar nan Mohap
oh kalowehdi dolen Arnon palipowe kan.
Meid kamasepwehk ong kumwail tohn Mohap!
Kumwail me kin kaudokiong Kemos, kumwail olahr!
Amwail koht keselahr noumwail sounpei kan,
nanmwarkien Amor koledier lih akan.
Ahpw met kadaudokarail kan kamwomwmwomwlahr,
sangete Espon lellahng Dipon,
sang Nasim lel Nopa, limwahn Medepa.”

content: Mehn Israel ko eri kousoanla nan sapwen mehn Amor ko.

content.text: Moses eri kadarala ohl ekei pwe re en rapahki wasa mwahu en mahwen ong mehn Saser. Mehn Israel ko ahpw kalowehdi wasao oh kahnimw ko me kapilpene oh kausasang mehn Amor me kin kausoan wasao.

content: Mehn Israel ko ahpw pwurala oh keid ni ahl me kolahng Pasan, oh Ok, nanmwarkien Pasan, ahpw mwekidla iangahki sapwellime karis pwehn mahweniong mehn Israel ko ni Edrei.

KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Moses, “Ke dehr masak nanmwarki menet. Pwe I pahn mweidohng uhk ke en kalowehdi ih, sapwellime aramas akan koaros iangahki sapweo. Wiahiong soahng me ke wiahiong Sihon, nanmwarkien mehn Amor kan, me kaunda Espon.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kemehla Ok, nah pwutak ko oh sapwellime aramas koaros, sohte emen luwehdi; mwuhr, re ahpw kousoanla nan sahpwo.

footnotes.text: KASARAWIONG...DOULUHL: Mehkot me kasarawiong KAUN-O ni mwohmw wet pahn wiahla douluhl sapwellimen KAUN-O, oh sohte me kak doadoahngki. e pahn kamwomwmwomwla.
ORMA: Ahd wet ni mahsen en Ipru wehwehki “mwomwla.”
